title: Show HN: TeXbrain, a LaTeX editor that runs pdfTeX in the browser via WASM
summary: TeXbrain is a browser-based LaTeX editor that compiles pdfTeX to WebAssembly, allowing users to write LaTeX and get PDFs without any backend server. Built by a master's engineering student who wanted to avoid Overleaf's paid git sync feature, it stores all files locally in one folder on the user's disk as a static site.
problem_solved: Provides a free, local-first LaTeX editor with PDF compilation without requiring subscriptions or cloud services for essential features like version control.
why_valuable: It democratizes access to LaTeX editing by eliminating subscription costs while keeping all files local on the user's disk, giving full control and privacy over documents.
